en.自然语言版与 tags 版逐条一一对应（换底模时用）: Natural language matches each tag prompt (for switching models).
en.选角色后自动套用其性格剧情包: Select a character to use their personality story.
en.无专属包，回落通用模板: No dedicated story; using general story
en.登录尝试过多，请稍后重试: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
en.尺寸须为 256–1536 之间的 64 倍数: Dimensions must be multiples of 64 from 256 to 1536
en.种子须为非负安全整数: Seed must be a non-negative safe integer
en.session_id 须为 UUID: Session ID must be a UUID
en.页码须为 1–20: Page number must be from 1 to 20
en.request_id 须为 UUID: Request ID must be a UUID
en.工作流尚未登记，请先启动本机程序: Workflow is not registered. Start the local service first.
en.重复请求的参数不同: Retry parameters differ from the original request
en.队列已满，请等任务完成: Queue is full. Wait for current tasks to finish.
en.会话 ID 和 request_id 须为 UUID，replace 须为布尔值: Batch and request IDs must be UUIDs; replace must be a boolean
en.config 必须是对象: Batch configuration must be an object
en.会话冲突，请确认替换当前批次并使用新的 request_id: Batch conflict. Confirm replacement and use a new request ID.
en.本机取图通道尚未连接: Local image connection is not available
en.取图连接失败，请稍后重试: Image connection failed. Please try again later.
en.本机原图暂时无法读取，请确认本机程序正在运行: Original image is unavailable. Check that the local service is running.
en.只能取消尚未开始的任务: Only queued tasks can be cancelled
en.请先取消排队任务，运行中的任务不能删除: Cancel queued tasks first. Running tasks cannot be deleted.
en.since 须为非负整数: Since must be a non-negative integer
en.after_id 须为空或 UUID: After ID must be empty or a UUID
en.执行程序已有任务，请先恢复该任务: Worker has an existing task. Resume it first.
en.每任务最多 8 张图片: Each task allows at most 8 images
en.任务失效或图片信息冲突: Task expired or image metadata conflicts
en.ComfyUI 任务 ID 不允许修改: Generation task ID cannot be changed
en.尚未收到图片: No image has been received yet
en.错误信息须为 1–1000 字符: Error message must contain from 1 to 1000 characters
en.会话已替换或参数已冻结，请开始新批次: Batch was replaced or parameters are frozen. Start a new batch.
en.服务暂时不可用，请检查数据库迁移和绑定: Service is unavailable. Check database setup.
